entrypoints.name: gsap-frameworks

entrypoints.name: gsap-performance
entrypoints.decision: Adapt measured frame/layout behavior and selective animation; no unconditional will-change.

entrypoints.name: gsap-plugins
entrypoints.decision: Use task-specific plugin discovery and installed-version documentation rather than bundle all recipes.

entrypoints.name: gsap-react

entrypoints.name: gsap-scrolltrigger

entrypoints.name: gsap-timeline
entrypoints.decision: Adapt labels, relative sequencing and explicit timeline ownership.

entrypoints.name: gsap-utils
entrypoints.decision: Use scoped selectors and appropriate utilities; no extra utility-only entrypoint.

repositories.review_scope: All SKILL.md paths, sizes and metadata inventoried; README/license/architecture and selected workflow/reference sections reviewed. Not an audit of every tracked file or a test of upstream software.

entrypoints.name: smui
entrypoints.decision: Exclude viewer-internal theme rules: no portable skill metadata and no Fénix need for that theme.

entrypoints.name: bambu-labs
entrypoints.decision: Adapt explicit machine/job identity and retry reconciliation; no live printer driver.

entrypoints.name: cad
entrypoints.decision: Implement original build123d example plus saved STEP/mesh inspection; do not vendor cadgen.

entrypoints.name: cad-viewer
entrypoints.decision: Adapt truthful visual inspection and artifact handoff; no new viewer/server implementation.

entrypoints.name: dfam-check
entrypoints.decision: Adapt process-specific manufacturability decisions; mesh closure does not prove wall thickness or strength.

entrypoints.name: dxf
entrypoints.decision: Implement original DXF units/entities/bounds checker; no full manufacturing validator.

entrypoints.name: gcode
entrypoints.decision: Adapt slicer/profile provenance and modal-command review; no universal G-code interpreter bundled.

entrypoints.name: sdf
entrypoints.decision: Adapt frame/version/plugin checks; native SDFormat/Gazebo validation remains required.

entrypoints.name: sendcutsend
entrypoints.decision: Adapt supplier/process constraints and drawing handoff; no quotation/order integration.

entrypoints.name: srdf
entrypoints.decision: Adapt MoveIt group/name/collision checks; native planner remains required.

entrypoints.name: step-parts
entrypoints.decision: Adapt catalog component identity, dimensions, provenance and simplified-envelope labeling.

entrypoints.name: urdf
entrypoints.decision: Implement original offline topology/limits/inertia validator with explicitly unverified physics.

repositories.review_scope: All SKILL.md paths, sizes and metadata inventoried; README/license/architecture and selected workflow/reference sections reviewed. Not an audit of every tracked file or a test of upstream software.

entrypoints.name: hf-mcp
entrypoints.decision: Use available native discovery/CLI/API or a configured connector; do not assume named upstream MCP tools exist.

entrypoints.name: hf-cli
entrypoints.decision: Adapt repo type, revisions, bounded files, supported installed CLI and job lifecycle.

entrypoints.name: hf-cloud-aws-context-discovery
entrypoints.decision: Adapt account/region identity and quotas; preserve existing access scope.

entrypoints.name: hf-cloud-python-env-setup
entrypoints.decision: Reuse existing environment workflow; no cloud-specific duplicate entrypoint.

entrypoints.name: hf-cloud-sagemaker-deployment-planner
entrypoints.decision: Adapt workload/latency pathway selection; no mandatory vendor path or broad trigger.

entrypoints.name: hf-cloud-sagemaker-iam-preflight
entrypoints.decision: Prefer suitable existing role and distinguish inaccessible preflight from denied deployment.

entrypoints.name: hf-cloud-sagemaker-production-defaults
entrypoints.decision: Adapt persisted resource IDs, actual inference, observability and scoped teardown; no deployment scripts copied.

entrypoints.name: hf-cloud-serving-image-selection
entrypoints.decision: Resolve current compatible container and API contract; no unconditional vendor image preference.

entrypoints.name: hf-mem
entrypoints.decision: Implement explicit nominal weights plus dense/GQA/MQA KV calculation; upstream header/Range inspection and other cache architectures are not reimplemented.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-best
entrypoints.decision: Adapt evidence-based comparison; reject name-derived model sizes and weights-only fit conclusions.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-community-evals
entrypoints.decision: Adapt task/metric/prompt/revision provenance; resolve frameworks instead of assuming a local checkout or missing skill.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-datasets
entrypoints.decision: Adapt config/split pagination and formats; do not upload raw agent session folders by default.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-gradio
entrypoints.decision: Adapt component contracts, session isolation, queue/cancellation and actual inference checks.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-llm-trainer
entrypoints.decision: Adapt objectives, saved artifacts and verification; no mandatory immediate hosted job or publication.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-local-models
entrypoints.decision: Adapt exact GGUF artifacts, compatible runtimes and measured load/request validation.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-lora-space-builder
entrypoints.decision: Adapt adapter/base compatibility and real demo outputs; no fixed copied app scaffold.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-paper-publisher
entrypoints.decision: Adapt explicit namespace/authorship and artifact links; preparing a paper does not publish it.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-papers
entrypoints.decision: Adapt paper/artifact discovery; social popularity does not establish scientific evidence.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-spaces
entrypoints.decision: Adapt build/runtime diagnostics, secrets and visibility; deployment still needs authorized external access.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-tool-builder
entrypoints.decision: Reuse existing API/tool-building workflow with Hub pagination and identity guidance.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-trackio
entrypoints.decision: Adapt local tracking and comparable metrics; explicitly control hosted dashboard visibility.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-vision-trainer
entrypoints.decision: Adapt label transforms, boxes/masks, task metrics and saved processor/model consistency.

entrypoints.name: huggingface-zerogpu
entrypoints.decision: Adapt supported SDK/GPU function boundaries and current quota checks; no hardcoded hardware promises.

entrypoints.name: train-sentence-transformers
entrypoints.decision: Adapt bi-/cross-encoder, sparse and late-interaction objectives, negatives and held-out retrieval evaluation.

entrypoints.name: transformers-js
entrypoints.decision: Add ONNX/processor compatibility, worker lifecycle, WebGPU/WASM fallback and real device checks.

entrypoints.name: trl-training
entrypoints.decision: Adapt SFT/preference/reward objective choice and installed APIs rather than duplicate a trainer skill.

checks: selectors remain inside the supplied root
normal animation reaches its readable end state
idempotent cleanup restores preexisting inline styles
cleanup leaves no owned tweens running
repeated mount and unmount do not accumulate tweens
disposing one component preserves another component's animation
a live reduced-motion change reverts movement and keeps content visible
initial reduced-motion preference creates no entrance tween
higher ScrollTrigger refreshPriority sorts before lower priority
static content remains visible without JavaScript
